facts.business: Gujarat Ambuja Exports Limited is a diversified agro-processing company with operations spanning maize processing, agro-processing, cotton yarn spinning, and renewable energy, catering to industries such as food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, paper, textiles, animal nutrition, construction chemicals, and industrial applications.
